mapper.select: /* Biz: 공통 (GscmCommonStore) */ SELECT CD_GRP_ID , CD , CD_NM , SORT_SEQ FROM COM_CODE_MST WHERE CD_GRP_ID = #{CD_GRP_ID} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ

/* Biz: 공통 (GscmCommonStore) */ SELECT A.TGT_CD , A.TGT_CD_NM , A.WORK_YM , A.QTY , A.AMT , A.RATE FROM COM_EXCEL_DOWN_VW A WHERE A.SEARCH_DT BETWEEN #{SEARCH_DT_FROM} AND #{SEARCH_DT_TO} ORDER BY A.WORK_YM DESC
